title: You and Other People's Eyes (People Pleaser Test)
description: How far do you change yourself to keep others happy and avoid conflict?

questions.pp_1: I change the way I talk or my taste in music depending on who I'm hanging out with.
questions.pp_2: I'd rather apologize even when I'm not wrong, as long as the argument ends quickly.
questions.pp_3: I always say yes when friends ask for help, even when my own schedule is already packed.
questions.pp_4: When asked 'Where do you want to eat?', I always answer 'Up to you' so they'll be happy.
questions.pp_5: My biggest fear is finding out someone is secretly angry or disappointed with me.
questions.pp_6: I feel guilty relaxing while people around me are working hard.
questions.pp_7: I often voice agreement with popular opinion, even though inside I strongly disagree.
questions.pp_8: I choose my words very carefully so I don't offend anyone (walking on eggshells).
questions.pp_9: My self-worth shoots up every time I feel needed or manage to help someone.
questions.pp_10: I feel I have no fixed personality or 'true self' when I'm alone without others.
questions.pp_11: If the service at a restaurant is terrible, I would never dare to complain directly to the staff.
questions.pp_12: I often feel emotionally exhausted from constantly holding everyone's venting and problems.
questions.pp_13: I laugh loudly at jokes that aren't funny at all just to keep the group's mood light.
questions.pp_14: I'm willing to spend more or lose money so friends won't call me stingy or difficult.
questions.pp_15: Saying 'No' feels like a huge sin or a betrayal to me.
questions.pp_16: I often exaggerate my enthusiasm for a friend's hobby so they'll like me.
questions.pp_17: When someone criticizes me, my first reflex is to smile and agree, then cry about it later in my room.
questions.pp_18: I tend to attract toxic (red-flag) people because I believe I have the power to 'fix' them.
questions.pp_19: I'm afraid to show my fragile, sad, or angry side because I want to always seem positive and fun.
questions.pp_20: I'm willing to hold back my ambitions or dreams if they make someone close to me feel threatened or envious.
questions.pp_21: I secretly feel resentful because I always help others, but rarely does anyone help me.
questions.pp_22: I copy the unique habits or style of people I admire so I'll look cool like them.
questions.pp_23: Facing a confrontation in person can make me shake, break into a cold sweat, and feel nauseous.
questions.pp_24: I feel my life is less meaningful if I'm not busy solving my family's or friends' problems.

results.description: You change your personality, hobbies, and opinions so you can always fit in with the people around you.
You're very afraid of conflict and anger, so you'll swallow your own opinions to keep things harmonious.
You struggle to say 'no' because you feel your worth depends on how useful you are to others.
